translations.web: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
translations.bsb: Let the assembled peoples gather around You; take Your seat over them on high.
translations.kjv: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
translations.asv: And let the congregation of the peoples compass thee about; And over them return thou on high.
